Checked on both builds: all four sides open and close, Escape closes (dispatched keydown), focus returns to the trigger, body overflow hidden on both, role dialog, focus lands on a button inside. Not checked: 1280x900 and 390x844 screenshots, outside click, Tab order, reduced motion, real screen reader, reference animation frames, lint/typecheck/build/check:gallery. reasonNotMoved: Base UI's scroll lock leaves scrollbar-gutter: stable on html, so while any sheet is open the viewport is 15px narrower: the overlay leaves a 15px strip, top/bottom sheets are 485px instead of 500px, side sheets are 3/4 of the narrower width, and the close button shifts left (upstream: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/12107, https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/4645). Attribute differences on trigger and close button and unconfirmed animation timing are secondary. Retry once the gutter issue is fixed or the team accepts the layout shift, and verify at 1280x900 and 390x844.
